title: Add Range, removing a range and moving an end change every column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, two ranges ($0.00 to $100.00 and $100.01 and up), Default 40% markup and 30% markup, tier A 10% off and 5% off.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Change the first range's end to 150.
  5. Click Add Range.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The grid shows two ranges for every column.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The second range now starts at $150.01 for Default and for tier A alike.
  • Tier A keeps 10% off in the first range and 5% off in the second.

Step 5:

  • A third range appears in every column at once, Default and tier A alike.
